introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education (GCE) Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. History 2 (0560), Paper 2 - Modern World History Since 1870, ORDINARY LEVEL, June 2021. Duration: two and a half hours.**

Instructions to candidates: Answer FOUR Questions. TWO questions must be chosen from SECTION A, ONE from SECTION B and ONE other from SECTION C. One of the two questions chosen from SECTION A must be a Starred question.

Maps should be used to illustrate answers where appropriate. All questions carry equal marks.

You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers.

**SECTION C: WORLD DIPLOMACY SINCE 1870**

Answer ONE Question from this section.
incertitudes: Question 10 : le sujet imprime « (5/5/5/5marks) » (espace manquant) : 5 points pour l'organisation de l'ONU et 5 points par organisme, trois organismes sur quatre à traiter (« any three »). 10. Describe the organisation of the United Nations Organisation.
What part have any **three** of the following United Nations Agencies played in the development of African States since 1970 in improving the welfare and wellbeing of the people?

(a) FAO

(b) UNICEF

(c) UNESCO

(d) WHO

**(5/5/5/5marks)**
